collectible.title: Bottomless Picture
collectible.subtitle: She teased you about it, and delivered
collectible.text: She teased you about it earlier, so she delivered!
collectible.unlock: Play with her a few times and she will tease you about taking off her panties first. Then win!

collectible.title: Serena's Fennekin Ears
collectible.subtitle: Hot air doesn't billow from them.
collectible.text: The Fennekin ears from Seren's Fennekin Cosplay outfit. When she handed them to you, she assured you they would not burn you. Yes, they are fluffy.
collectible.unlock: Win against Serena while she's wearing her Fennekin outfit.

collectible.title: Serena's Sun Glasses
collectible.subtitle: Simple, yet stylish.
collectible.text: You can wear them to curb her shinning countenance!
collectible.unlock: Win a game against Serena in her default costume.

collectible.title: Serena's Fennekin Booty
collectible.subtitle: Just don't spread it around the internet.
collectible.text: She gathered a fair amount of courage to share this with you. You are one lucky individual!
collectible.unlock: Play a game with Serena in her Fennekin outfit. Wear the Fennekin Ears and win, finishing the game with them still on.

collectible.title: Serena's Fischl Card
collectible.subtitle: Don't worry... Serena Won't Steal It!
collectible.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you secretly keep the dress. If tails, you give it back.
collectible.unlock: Play with Serena and Fischl. Have Serena try on her dress.

collectible.title: Mikan-Serena Figurine
collectible.subtitle: Non 2d Version of Mikan-Serena
collectible.text: You'll display her proudly on your shelf, won't you?
collectible.unlock: Play with Mikan and Serena. Have Serena try on her dress.
